rationale: A legal drama about an attorney appealing his Klansman grandfather's death sentence, but nothing in the plot suggests the grandfather is innocent, so the wrongly-accused element is missing.
A detective suffering blackouts fears she committed a string of murders of her lovers, and the reveal that her mentor Mills is the killer gives a dark psychological thriller with a clear twist.

Set during Scotland's war with England with Wallace's secret marriage to Murron and a later affair with Isabella, but the romance mainly motivates a rebellion and battle epic rather than being the story.

Time travel is central as H.G. Wells chases Jack the Ripper to 1979, but it is a pursuit story and the only attempt to alter events targets murders foreseen in a future newspaper rather than changing the past.
A family moves into a house where the previous family was murdered, a demonic figure and ghost children appear in the house, and the family is ultimately killed, matching family, haunting and house.
Marty travels back to 1955, disrupts and then repairs his parents' meeting, and returns to a 1985 in which his family's lives have been changed.

A short plot about a lonely man stalking a TV anchor with a 'sudden turn' when she learns his secret hints at a thriller with a twist, but the text reads as a romance with little dark psychological content.
A doctor and a war correspondent fall in love in Hong Kong during China's Civil War, and he is killed while reporting on the Korean War.
An Antwerp diamond heist opens the film, but the rest is a chaotic chase for the stolen diamond among gangsters and bungling small-time crooks, not a heist planned by a professional crew.
The Enterprise-B is caught in an energy ribbon that breaches its hull and the Enterprise-D saucer later crash-lands, but the story is about stopping Soran, not about surviving an accident.
Two British sci-fi fans take a comic RV road trip across the US with a crude escaped alien, a mismatched companion they must hide from agents.
The plot text is a love story between a working-class man and a rich girl, but it never mentions a war, which appears only in the genre label.
Donnie is given The Philosophy of Time Travel and the last 28 days rewind to October 2, where his death in the jet-engine crash changes what happened to everyone else.
A comic farce about a writer forced to rob a bank who hides out at his ex-wife's house, with no road trip and no mismatched travelling pair, so only the comedy genre matches.
Three Marines on shore leave during WWII go through proposals, broken engagements and new romances before returning to battle, with Nico's last love letter carried home to his fiancee.
A husband systematically convinces his wife she is going mad, and the reveal that he is her aunt's murderer Sergius Bauer makes this a dark psychological thriller with a twist.
Three friends fall through time leaks in a pub and meet their past selves, and destroying the note breaks causality so that time rewinds, changing history.
Career criminal McCauley's professional crew carries out a planned armored-car heist and a big bank robbery while a detective hunts them.
Three very different women take a cross-country road trip, but the plot is dominated by an accidental killing, AIDS and Robin's death, not comedy.
A lonely girl adopts a stray dog and through it befriends an elderly librarian, a blind recluse rumored to be a witch and a shy ex-convict, a heartwarming story of unlikely friendships.
Time travelers from a dying future snatch passengers from doomed planes, and their interference with the past causes timequakes and a major change to the timeline.
A Depression-era boxing comeback story with no trial, courtroom or false accusation anywhere in the plot.
A slasher parody in which the masked killer 'Ghostface' stalks teenagers; there is no actual ghost, haunted house or terrorized family.
A family barricades itself in its farmhouse as intruders get inside, but the attackers are aliens, not a ghost, and the house is not haunted.
A collision during a shuttle satellite launch kills an astronaut, but the rest of the plot is a government UFO cover-up on Earth with no survival in space.
The tone is warm and Edward's tall tales include a misunderstood giant and circus friends, but the core story is a father-son reconciliation, not a friendship.
A heartwarming story whose moral is that 'no man is a failure who has friends', but the unlikely bond with guardian angel Clarence is one episode and the story is about George's life and town.

A suspenseful spy thriller with slow poisoning, but it has no psychological manipulation or twist; the black sand hidden in wine bottles is an investigative find, not a reveal that reframes the story.
Will faces jail for an assault he did commit, which is settled off-screen by a deal; the story is about therapy and his future, with no courtroom drama or false accusation.
Yuri Zhivago and Lara's love affair unfolds across World War I, the Russian Revolution and the Civil War.
A supernatural revenge-ghost horror about the 'Tooth Fairy' with no psychological thriller plot and no twist; the match seems driven by 'Darkness' in the title.
An American family moves into a house in Spain built for an occult ritual, where ghostly child figures and a supernatural darkness torment and finally kill them.
The plot text is a comic modern fable with a Greek chorus whose stated twist is that the birth mother is pregnant with Lenny's child; there is a twist but nothing dark or thrilling.
A revenge plot against the Romulan Nero with space battles; the Kelvin is destroyed in an attack, not an accident, and survival after a spacecraft accident is never the story.
A retired cat burglar hunts a copycat jewel thief who turns out to be working with his old gang, but it is a romantic mystery about clearing his name, not a heist planned by a crew.
In the Discovery section HAL's malfunction kills Poole and Bowman survives vacuum exposure to shut HAL down, but this is deliberate sabotage rather than an accident and only one of four sections.
A Quaker family's struggle with pacifism during the Civil War, with no friendship between unlikely companions; the match seems driven by 'Friendly' in the title.
A defense attorney fights for Jeff McCullaugh, an innocent man convicted through mistaken identity, in a courtroom-centered drama that ends with his outburst at the rape trial of a guilty judge.
The crippled Enterprise must escape the Genesis blast and Spock dies restoring the warp drive, but the damage comes from combat with Khan rather than an accident.
Five professional criminals join forces to plan and carry out a robbery of corrupt police escorts, a jewel job and an attack on a ship, capped by the Keyser Soze reveal.
A chase and conspiracy story about River and the Reavers; the only 'accident' is a planet's terraforming disaster, and Serenity's crash landing comes from combat, not a spacecraft accident.
A poor family inherits a house haunted by twelve ghosts and is menaced by them and by a murderous lawyer until he becomes the thirteenth ghost.
A spoiled heiress and a cynical reporter travel by bus and by hitchhiking in a comic cross-country trip during which they fall in love.
Four ghosts killed in a bus crash are bound to a boy born at that moment and, years later, bond with him as he helps each finish their business, a heartwarming friendship of unlikely companions.
A prosecutor is tried for his colleague's murder on planted evidence, the charges are dismissed, and his wife turns out to be the killer.
A heartwarming bond between an amnesiac shell-shocked soldier and a singer who befriends him, but it is a romance and marriage story, not a friendship.
A comic 1,800-mile road trip, but by a group of four college friends rather than a mismatched pair.
Set in Sicily during WWII, a boy's devoted infatuation with Malena and her faithfulness to her soldier husband, who returns to reclaim her, make up a wartime love story.
A masked human killer stalks babysitters on Halloween; there is no ghost, haunted house or terrorized family.
A solitary old professor ends up alone and dies in the snow, which gives a bleak loneliness frame, but most of the plot is a metaphysical adventure about rejuvenation, Nazis and reincarnation.
A troubled teen with hallucinations of a rabbit figure is diagnosed with paranoid schizophrenia, and the timeline rewinding to his death at the end supplies the twist.
A traumatized psychoanalyst investigates the murder of a colleague among disturbed patients, leading to an explicit twist ending that the patient Richie is really his lover Rose.
Joe is arrested on flimsy evidence for a kidnapping he did not commit, a mob burns the jail, and the courtroom trial of the lynch mob ends when he walks into court.
A jury deliberates the murder case of a young man, and Juror 8 methodically shows the evidence against him to be unreliable.

A grim ensemble of unfulfilled people, including a sister back to being alone, a father who 'wants to be alone' and a depressed neighbor, set against suicide and abuse, makes a bleak film about loneliness.
There is no time travel; the plot covers the monolith, HAL and the Star-Gate transformation, so only the sci-fi genre overlaps.
A fire destroys Mir during refueling and the Independence shuttle is holed and crashes, with survivors, but these are episodes in an asteroid-drilling mission.
A bleak noir about a violent screenwriter suspected of murder whose romance collapses under suspicion, but loneliness is never shown in the plot and appears only in the title.
Ghosts and haunted houses are central to a psychic con man's fight against a serial-killer ghost, but no family is terrorized in its own haunted home.
About a lonely woman's longing for friends, but it turns into horror as she murders people to stitch together a 'friend' from their body parts, the opposite of heartwarming.
The crew time-travels to 1986 to fetch humpback whales; the power drain and crash in San Francisco Bay are minor and on Earth, with no survival in space.
A space-accident survival story with no time travel and no change to the past.
An alienated teen who longs for commitment and suicides give a bleak, surreal atmosphere, but the plot is a chaotic, absurdist party ensemble ending in an alien, not a focused study of loneliness.
A Grail quest adventure whose only jump in time is a 1912 flashback, with no time travel.
Set squarely in the Civil War with the 54th Massachusetts, but the plot has no love story at all.
The Air France robbery and Lufthansa heist occur, but only briefly within a broader mob-life story about Henry Hill.
An abstinence-promoting teen and his Playboy-obsessed best friend take a comic cross-country trip to the Playboy Mansion.
A space-opera rescue and rebellion story in which ships are captured and attacked, with no accident on a spacecraft and no survival struggle.
A defensive genius janitor and a grieving community-college therapist form an unlikely, healing bond, alongside Chuckie's loyal friendship, ending on a hopeful note.
A family's home is haunted by the spirit of a murdered girl who plagues the father until he finds her body in the basement.
A fugitive family drama about parents letting their son pursue Juilliard; nothing in the plot is bleak or about loneliness.
A solitary cowboy who rejects modern society meets a bleak end on a rainy highway, but the story is a jailbreak and manhunt about freedom rather than about loneliness.
A light comedy about a young woman modernizing her eccentric rural relatives, neither bleak nor about loneliness; the match seems driven by 'Cold Comfort' in the title.
A sensual, playful story of a priest's wife awakened by an artist's bohemian estate, with nothing bleak or lonely.
Danny Ocean assembles eleven specialist thieves who meticulously plan and execute a robbery of the Bellagio vault.
An oxygen tank explodes on Apollo 13 and the crew must survive cold, CO2 build-up and power shortages to get home.
A romantic comedy about a mismatched couple, a straight-laced New York architect and a free-spirited photographer, but there is no road trip.
The Freeling family's house is invaded by ghosts from a cemetery beneath it, and they abduct the youngest daughter.
A divorced mother rebuilds her life with her family and a new romance; there is no friendship between unlikely companions, only a gently uplifting tone.
